name: stealth-reader
description: ZBRS 技术工具工坊 monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stealth-reader/shared && npm run build --workspace @stealth-reader/backend && npm run build --workspace @stealth-reader/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @stealth-reader/backend && npm run test --workspace @stealth-reader/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @stealth-reader/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @stealth-reader/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @stealth-reader/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
